items.headline: Supreme Court again blocks Missouri's gerrymandered congressional map
items.summary: The Supreme Court blocked Missouri from using a newly drawn congressional map that would have eliminated a Democratic-held seat, ordering the state to use its 2022 map for the November elections instead. The order came with no noted dissents, in response to an emergency request from a group backing a voter referendum on the map.
items.why_it_matters: It stops a mid-decade partisan redistricting push from taking effect before voters can weigh in, protecting a fairer district map through the midterm elections.
